Class ViewManager

java.lang.Object
ViewManager
public class ViewManager extends Object
Manages view transformations including zoom, pan, and coordinate scaling. Handles automatic network fitting and interactive view manipulation.
Version:
2.0
Author:
M A T^2 H Team
